---
title: Baggage allowance
audiences: [ANY]
category: FLIGHTS
phrasings:
  - how many bags
  - luggage weight limit
  - suitcase size
  - carry-on
---

Economy fares include one cabin bag of 8 kg and one checked suitcase of 23 kg. A second checked bag costs extra and must be added before departure. Sports equipment travels as a special item.
